policies.title: Lao ordinary passports: Grenada advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Grenada's active Embassy-linked nationality schedule places the Lao People's Democratic Republic in its prior-to-arrival cohort.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Lao passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
Grenada's schedule defines Prior to Arrival as a visa obtained from a Grenadian mission or consulate before travel.
Work, residence, study, transit, special documents and final admission remain outside scope.

policies.title: Lao ordinary passports: Panama authorized visitor visa
policies.summary: Panama's live Embassy schedule places Laos in its authorized-visa cohort for advance consular approval.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Lao passport holder who does not qualify for Panama's separate third-country visa or residence waiver.
The cited Embassy says authorized-visa approval may take up to 60 business days and requires an in-person consular application.
Work, residence, transit, special documents and final admission remain outside scope.
